headline: Approved temporary fire lieutenant to fill an FMLA opening; accepted minutes and fire chief's report.
summary: Fire Chief Kadlewicz reported on two injured firefighters, light duty, and overtime spending. The overtime budget is $506,356.00, with $201,858.86 spent and $304,497.14 left. Updates on the headquarters roof and Station 3 waterproofing were also given, and the waterproofing work starts in Spring 2027.

transcript:
# Board of Fire Commission Meeting Minutes

Date: September 9, 2026
Time: 5:00 p.m.
Location: Fire Department Headquarters

Meeting called by: Chairman Trask
Note taker: D. Glenn
Type of meeting: Regular Monthly
Timekeeper: D. Glenn
Facilitator: Chief Kadlewicz
Approved

Attendees: Jeffrey Trask, George Mettey, Nelson Lopez
Absent:
Staff in Attendance: Chief John Kadlewicz and Dale Glenn
Also:

## A. Opening of Meeting

Chairman Mettey
Time: 5:00 p.m.

### #1 – Call to Order

Commissioner Trask opened the meeting of the Board of Fire Commissioners with a verbal roll call of those present, followed by the Pledge of Allegiance and a prayer by Commissioner Mettey.

### #2 – Minutes

The Board of Fire Commissioners reviewed the minutes from the August 19, 2026 meeting.

### #3 – Fire Chief's Report

Fire Chief Kadlewicz provided the Board with updates regarding:

- Injured on Duty (IOD), Light Duty, Administrative Duty, Administrative Leave, Overtime Expenditures

### #4 – Old Business

**Headquarters Roof Project:** Roofing company has been selected and is moving forward.

**Station 3 Waterproofing Project:** This project will begin in Spring 2027.

### #5 – New Business

**Temporary Fire Lieutenant:** Chief Kadlewicz reqested from the Board to have the next person on the list for temporary fire lieutenant to be able to step into the open lieutenant position to be in compliance with Civil Service due to an FMLA .

### #6 – Executive Session

An Executive Session was not needed for this meeting.

### #7 – Adjournment

The meeting was closed

## Motions

Motions: Commissioner Trask entertained a motion to accept the minutes from August 19, 2026, Commissioner Mettey made the motion and was 2nd byCommissioner Trask; motion carried

Commissioner Trask entertained a motion to accept the Fire Chief's report, Commissioner Mettey made the motion and was 2nd by Commissioner Lopez; motion carried.

Commissioner Trask entertained a motion to select the next eligle person on the current Fire Lieutenant Certification to fill in as a Temporary Fire Lieutenant due to an FMLA opening, Commissioner Mettey made the motion and was 2nd by Commissioner Lopez; motion carried.

Commissioner Trask entertained a motion to adjourn, Commissioner Mettey made the motion and was 2nd by Commissioner Trask; motion carried. Meeting adjourned at 5:15pm
